_about: Deterministic stimuli for the human-in-the-loop study. Generated by build_scenarios.py from the A/B gold queries; do not edit by hand.

scenarios.question: How many different products are associated with the store 'Santa Cruz Bikes'?
scenarios.clarification_question: For 'Santa Cruz Bikes', which set of products do you mean?

interpretations.option_label: Products currently available in the shop's own inventory
Products that customers have purchased there

goals.text: You manage the Santa Cruz Bikes shop. You want to know how many different products are physically available in that shop right now.
You're reviewing sales at the Santa Cruz Bikes shop. You want to know how many different products customers have actually bought there over time.

scenarios.question: How many staff members are associated with customer 1?
scenarios.clarification_question: For customer #1, which employees do you mean?

interpretations.option_label: Only employees who personally handled this customer's purchases
All employees who work at the shop(s) this customer bought from

goals.text: You're looking at customer #1's history. You want to know how many individual employees personally dealt with this customer's purchases.
You're looking at customer #1. You want to know how many employees in total work at the shop(s) this customer has bought from — everyone there, whether or not they served this customer.

scenarios.question: How many different types of lab test are associated with patient 10006?
scenarios.clarification_question: For patient #10006, which lab tests should we count?

interpretations.option_label: Every lab test anywhere in the patient's record
Only lab tests done during the patient's hospital stays

goals.text: You're reviewing patient #10006's full medical history. You want to know how many different kinds of lab test this patient has ever had — including any taken outside of a hospital stay.
You're auditing patient #10006's hospital stays. You want to know how many different kinds of lab test were done while this patient was admitted to the hospital.

scenarios.question: How many different types of lab test are associated with ICU stay 204132?

goals.text: You're looking at ICU stay #204132. You want to know how many different kinds of lab test were done during that particular hospital stay.
You're looking at the patient who had ICU stay #204132. You want to know how many different kinds of lab test that patient has had in their whole record, across everything.
